method: RestCountries national populations spread across a ~2° sample grid inside each Natural Earth country polygon; each sample uses NASA POWER GHI. Captures north–south spread (e.g. Arctic vs capital) unlike a single centroid. For gridded census-based totals, add GPW 1° GeoTIFF at scripts/cache/gpw-pop-count-2020-1deg.tif and re-run.
